summary: Iteration 3 verification of the paced DuckDuckGo-first search_dork collector + display-path regression. Backend: 97 tests passing (10 new in test_run_guard.py, 85 existing in backend_test.py/test_social_display.py, 2 new PDF sweep). Confirmed POST /api/tenants/{AIG}/run?collector=search_dork returns 200 {ok:true} in <1s, runs in background (~230s / 13 platforms with 10s pacing), overlapping run returns 200 'A scan is already running for this tenant', guard released after completion, 404 for unknown tenant, 403 for viewer. monitoring-health shows a Search/Dorking row with status 'degraded' and the human-readable message 'Search engines returned no brand-relevant results for this server IP (datacenter IPs...)'. No new traceback / 'Task exception never retrieved' in backend.err.log during or after the run, and the API stayed fully responsive during the in-flight scan (GET /api/findings ~0.11s). Frontend: Stripe social page shows 1-25 of 69, platform dropdown lists all 13 expanded platforms, platform/Finding Type/Verification filters + search + reset (restores 69) + pagination + finding drawer + CSV export all work; all 4 role logins work; All Findings shows 211; report.pdf 200 for every tenant x module combination.

minor.issue: Stale 'running' rows are never reconciled. If the backend restarts/hot-reloads mid-scan the background task dies but collector_health keeps status='running' forever (currently 2 such rows: Netflix certificate_transparency since 14:16, Welspun search_dork since 15:03). Add a startup reconciliation (mark orphaned 'running' rows as 'failed'/'stale') or a started_at-based timeout.

While a collector is 'running', the row still carries the PREVIOUS run's error/items_found/last_run/duration_ms (the $set for 'running' does not clear them), so the UI can show a running scan next to a stale 'Degraded' error text. Clear error/items_found on the 'running' update.
_RUNNING_SCANS is in-process memory only, so the overlap guard is lost on restart and would not hold with >1 uvicorn worker. Acceptable today (single worker) - note only.

ui_bugs.issue: Orphaned 'Running' row renders with an empty Collector cell and '—' for Last Run/Found/New (row written before COLLECTOR_NAMES existed). Cosmetic consequence of the stale-running backend issue above.
Radix a11y console error on every drawer open: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' + 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Add a (visually hidden) DialogTitle/Description.

action_items: Reconcile orphaned 'running' collector_health rows (startup sweep or started_at timeout) so the Monitoring Health page never shows a permanently 'Running' collector.
Clear error/items_found/duration_ms when setting a collector row to 'running' so stale degraded messages are not shown mid-scan.
Add a hidden DialogTitle/Description to the finding drawer to remove the Radix a11y console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py run_now: correct fast-return + guard, but the _RUNNING_SCANS set is process-local; if the app is ever run with multiple workers the guard silently stops working. Consider a DB-backed lock keyed on tenant_id with a TTL (also solves the stale 'running' row problem).

backend/collectors.py collect_search_dork: 220s deadline vs 13 platforms x 10s sleep + per-platform backend rotation means later platforms in DORK_TARGETS (Reddit/Pastebin/Scribd) are frequently never queried when earlier ones are slow. Consider randomising/rotating platform order across runs so coverage is even over time.

backend/collectors.py: time.sleep(10) runs inside the asyncio.to_thread worker; with several tenants scanning concurrently the default thread-pool (min(32, cpu+4)) can be occupied for minutes by pure sleeping. A bounded semaphore or asyncio-side pacing would be cheaper.
backend/server.py is 1139 lines - consider splitting routes (findings/export/admin/monitoring) into routers per the <700-line guideline.

Poll health with a >=340s deadline.
